text:
Nora: quick sync  are we comfortable shipping the first-run onboarding as a small guided "mini-tour" overlay (step panels) or as an inline persistent checklist in the console sidebar? Leaning checklist for discoverability.
Ethan: checklist for me. Mini-tour can feel ephemeral; checklist surfaces progress and signals product value.
Priya: agree checklist. We tested a persistent checklist vs modal tour last quarter and checklist improved D1 activation by ~12%.
Sam: implementation note: sidebar checklist needs state persisted per-user. Could use localStorage for MVP then server state later. Mini-tour is stateless but less sticky.
Lina: accessibility: checklist in sidebar must be reachable via skip-link, have semantic list markup, and allow keyboard toggles for each step. If we do mini-tour, ensure each step has aria-describedby and focus is trapped only while the step is active.
Nora: good points. How about a hybrid: show mini-tour overlay the first time to draw attention, but also create/checklist entry in sidebar so users can resume later?
Ethan: hybrid sounds reasonable. Show overlay once (aria-live announce), then reveal checklist item in sidebar. That gives both discoverability and persistence.
Priya: copy for overlay step 1: "Create your first project" CTA = "Create project". Sidebar copy: "Onboarding checklist" with microcopy "Complete these to see Redwood in your app."
Sam: dev approach: overlay triggers a URL param like ?onboard_tour=1 and when completed set localStorage 'onboard_seen_v2'=true and add checklist item via client sync. Quick snippet:
```js
// open project with tour param
router.push(`/projects/new?onboard_tour=1`)
localStorage.setItem('onboard_seen_v2', 'true')
```
Lina: a11y checklist for hybrid: 1) aria-live announce overlay only on first render, 2) focus management (overlay -> main -> return), 3) sidebar items keyboard operable, 4) color contrast AA. I'll add to PR template.
Nora: analytics: tour_shown, tour_step_completed, checklist_item_completed, checklist_viewed. Priya can own funnel.
Priya: will add events and a small retention pulse for D1/D7.
handoff-bot: Reminder: attach Figma frames and component tokens; flag which variant is MVP.
Nora: decision: ship hybrid: one-time mini-tour overlay for new users + persistent sidebar checklist entry. Use localStorage for MVP state, route param to trigger, instrument events, and add a11y checklist in PR. Sam to spike storage approach, Lina to add a11y checks, Priya to own analytics.
Sam: starting spike now, will post branch link when ready.
Lina: I'll run the keyboard + screen reader pass on PR.
Priya: drafting events today.
Nora: thanks team  moving to sprint board as "onboard-hybrid-mvp" :rocket:
